cost: N lessons: hashing total identity bytes plus O(sum_s n_s log n_s) comparisons and O(N) storage; sorting selected indices O(K log K). Trace score O(trace bytes), width 15 per accepted row. Course execution and external parser/cache costs remain unknown.
description: Options choose a validated course identifier, seed, explicit tier/round or automatic cursor+1. Selection groups by stars, ranks (SHA256(seed NUL course NUL lesson-number), original index), keeps ceil(group-size/divisor) and restores chronological indices. A plan returns before run creation or course execution. A real run writes plan, invokes run_course_lessons with the selected Lesson clones, validates and scores trace, writes report/result, then advances cursor only in automatic mode.

inverse: Universe is normal-return argument/lesson/trace/artifact transitions with fixed dependencies. Inner absence constraints exclude unsupported tier strings, zero explicit round, simultaneous round and tier, out-of-range selection indices, and successful trace scoring with wrong width/count. This is not a full complement of external course execution or failed I/O traces.

For fixed lesson list and seed, observations of selected indices admit every tier yielding that subset; singleton strata make all tiers indistinguishable. Result totals admit many traces/questions and learning histories. Cursor alone cannot reconstruct manual runs, failures or previous artifacts.
limitations: Partial source models and finite native evidence; no live lesson edits, parser, teacher, run-course, GPU or held-out benchmarks.
External filesystem errors can preserve earlier effects; syntax is partial, macro bodies opaque.
state: Selection indices are unique and ordered; quick is contained in medium contained in full for identical lessons and seed. Scores observe recorded rows, not lesson semantics. Automatic cursor advances only after result write succeeds; previous effects are not rolled back on failure.
